name: session-handoff-button
description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, colored by context usage; reads Context clean and cannot be pressed while green. From orange on, one press writes the handoff, copies it, runs /clear and sends it to the fresh session.

skill.title: Handoff skill
skill.description: Slash command that writes the handoff (without the slash). When it is not installed, the built-in handoff prompt is used.

autoSend.title: Send automatically
autoSend.description: After /clear, send the handoff to the fresh session. Off: put it in the prompt box and wait for Enter.
